mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% over the last three months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in the last month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% QoQ and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
